title: NeuroSense featuring the VP Quality and Compliance
summary: “It wasn’t until I started working at NeuroSense that I realized how much my life has been affected by ALS. When I was eleven years old, my grandfather passed away from the condition, and this personal experience has been a significant motivator in my professional journey”
